reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Ungrateful Wife (Book IV); the monkey and crocodile frame and its 'never trust a woman' verse are omitted and disclosed, so the story is about one betrayal, not women in general.
Age band 16+, shelved in ಚಿತ್ರಕಥೆ: nothing sexual; the union is a secret promise of marriage. The singer who cannot walk is described plainly and with dignity and keeps his role in the plot.

Fixed before approval: the wife's pressure is Ryder's indirect form (a woman's death on his head) rather than a direct threat to die, the content note now mentions it, and a disclosure about how the narrator describes the singer was corrected.
Caste labels are removed and disclosed; every scene is a full page with dialogue; the deaths and the death sentence are calm. No em dashes.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, under 650 KB; one Codex gpt-5.6-sol generation with seams exactly at x=512 and y=512/1024; no text.
Fixed before approval: one edit pass removed a small red tilak-like dot from the husband's forehead in panel 1, matching the other panels; only that panel was composited back.
The singer is always seated and dignified; no push, fall or death is drawn; the wife is absent from panel 6; everyone is fully clothed and nothing is sexual.
Three alt texts were corrected to match the pictures. No caste markers or gods; similar natural skin tones.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels; edited panels were re-checked by a separate agent.
